text:
zoe: Morning team — quick sync on the OrchidNova RFI. I uploaded capability_matrix.csv + rfi_responses.md to /deals/orchidnova/rfi. Buyer wants: POC throughput, HSM/KMS options, VPC peering diagram, and three pricing bands incl. a single-month dedicated POC fee. Can ops/security/finance review by EOD Thu?

carlos: I'll take HSM/KMS. Quick boilerplate we can reuse: Private = BYO-HSM (PKCS#11) + optional private control plane; Dedicated = CMEK/cloud-KMS support with customer key ownership; Hosted = cloud KMS only; we do not persist raw key material. Will add attestation note.

darin: Ops: baseline POC numbers depend on model and prompt shape. Conservative lines for RFI: `13B (4xA100): ~370 req/s (16 tok avg)`; `70B (8xA100 equiv): ~88 req/s`. Will paste a tiny CSV and assumptions.

priya: Finance: buyer requests bands at 30k, 300k, 1.5M tokens/mo + dedicated POC month rate. I need a quick hosted vs dedicated delta. Also they asked about cancellation and an egress liability cap.

zoe: Also they asked for eu-north-1 residency. Can we confirm region locking for Dedicated/Private and note control-plane caveat?

carlos: Data residency note: yes — Dedicated/Private can be region-restricted via routing policy. Control plane (console/analytics) defaults to us-east-1 unless customer purchases private control plane add-on. I'll add that sentence.

darin: CSV snippet:```
model,instance,baseline_reqs_s,burst_reqs_s,assumptions
orch-13b,4xA100,370,650,16 token avg; warmed KV cache
orch-70b,8xA100,88,160,16 token avg; large-context opts
emb-fast,2xA100,1250,1950,embedding-only
```

carlos: Draft HSM paragraph: "Private deployments support customer-provided HSMs via PKCS#11/NSS with an integration guide and recommended attestation steps; customer is responsible for key lifecycle. Dedicated supports cloud KMS/CMEK with customer key ownership. Hosted integrates with provider KMS only; we do not access or persist raw key material. For FIPS-validated HSMs, Private is recommended."

priya: Quick finance note: tentatively hosted base rate = $0.0008/token band 30k; dedicated +18% for same bands; POC-month flat fee = $13k (legal to confirm). I'll post final numbers by Wed EOD. Also proposing an egress cap range we can offer: 0.5-1.5x MRR depending on term.

zoe: Buyer blockers they flagged: 1) legal wants proposed egress cap and sample liability clause; 2) infra wants a POC->prod runbook. Who owns runbook?

darin: Ops will own runbook. I'll draft a 2-page runbook with warmup steps, autoscale toggles, and rollback commands. Will include `kubectl` snippet and autoscaler config.

carlos: Also add a one-line fallback policy in the matrix: "If Dedicated capacity is exhausted, traffic may be routed to a compatible hosted variant with degraded SLA." Mark as caveat.

zoe: Action items: carlos finalize HSM paragraph + compliance note (due Wed EOD); darin finalize throughput CSV + runbook draft (due Wed noon); priya finalize pricing bands + egress cap suggestion (due Wed EOD); zoe assemble final RFI and trigger sign-off (due Thu morning).

priya: :thumbsup: I'll upload a short pricing table to the drive when ready.

darin: I'll paste the runbook skeleton here once drafted.

zoe: Thanks — scheduling 20m readthrough Thu 10am. If anything blocks post here.
